mapper.insert: replace INTO t_eastmoney_node (`date`,stockCode,infoRaw,`open`,`last`,high,low,volume,amount,exchangeRaw,clac_expma_5,clac_expma_10) with lastest_info as ( select ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.`last`, ten.infoRaw , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` desc) rank_ from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` > '2025-06-01' ) , one_info as ( select * from lastest_info tt where tt.rank_ = 1 ) select '99999+0.01' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999+0.01', ',0,', round(`last`*(1+0.01), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.00' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.00', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.00), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.01' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.01', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.01), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.02' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.02', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.02), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info union all select '99999-0.03' date, stockCode stockCode, concat('99999-0.03', ',0,', round(`last`*(1-0.03), 3), ',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0') infoRaw, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null from one_info
